openings.claim: Replace timestamp-led attribution with a manifest-ordered boundary ledger for all six pairs. Compare corresponding recorded digests; track equal, unequal, missing and uninspected boundaries in a spreadsheet or script. Cite records for definite stages, separate observed mismatches from explanations, and report earliest supported divergence or an unresolved interval with a feasible next check.
openings.discriminator: Against the nearest rival, timestamp-sorted first-mismatch attribution, the export-before-parse anomaly should remain an annotation rather than reorder evidence. Missing transform outputs should prevent unique earliest-stage attribution when earlier evidence cannot exclude alternatives. Claims or interval widths may differ; correctness remains unknown until sealed-sheet comparison. Defeat includes ambiguous boundary correspondence, exhausted inspections, or frozen intervals excluding injected boundaries.
openings.probe: Assign ledger and rival to the two disjoint three-pair subsets. Count every manual inspection, including repeats; stop at twelve per pair. During final review randomly remove one transform record from each of two pairs, leaving manifests unchanged. Freeze outputs before opening sealed sheets. Within twenty additional minutes compare unsupported definite claims, intervals containing injected boundaries, and next-check feasibility; unequal subset difficulty limits comparative inference.
openings.uncertainty: Dictionary-defined comparable boundaries are assumed; otherwise mark comparability unresolved. Expected manifest order proves neither execution nor causation. Equal recorded artifacts do not prove identical execution; absent records do not prove nonexecution, and blank warnings provide no affirmative explanation. Missing indispensable evidence widens uncertainty. Next checks use available supplied records within remaining inspections; otherwise state resources cannot resolve the interval. Sixty minutes may limit coverage: explicitly record unfinished checks. This proposes a bounded workflow, without measured improvement or causal diagnosis.
